class.name: JustAMCPPromptExecutor
class.brief_description: Lists, resolves, and completes prompts for MCP clients.

method.name: add_prompt
method.description: Registers a [JustAMCPPrompt] instance so it appears in [method list_prompts] and can be resolved by [method get_prompt]. Invalid prompt references are ignored.

method.name: complete_prompt
method.description: Looks up the prompt named by [param ref] and returns completion values for [param argument]. [param context] is the optional MCP completion context from [code]2025-06-18[/code] and later. Unknown prompts return an empty completion result.

method.name: get_prompt
method.description: Renders the prompt named by [param name] with [param args]. Returns an error dictionary when no registered prompt has that name.

method.name: list_prompts
method.description: Returns a paginated MCP [code]prompts/list[/code] dictionary with [code]prompts[/code] and optional [code]nextCursor[/code]. Invalid [param cursor] values return an error dictionary with code [code]-32602[/code]. When [param include_unlisted] is [code]false[/code], prompts disabled by the Prompts section toggle or a per-prompt toggle are omitted.
